resources.string: Protection for Google Play services on HyperOS
GMS Protect helps keep Google Play services available for push notifications on supported Xiaomi / HyperOS devices. Setup only takes a moment.
Allow GMS Protect to start after a reboot so protection can be restored automatically.

GMS Protect automatically adds itself, Google Play services and Play Store to MILLET. Tap Open battery settings to request Android battery exemption. Xiaomi PowerKeeper may have a separate No restrictions setting.
You can close the app. Protection will be restored automatically after reboot.
Protection is also refreshed every time you open GMS Protect.
GMS Protect is an independent utility and is not affiliated with Google or Xiaomi. Behavior may vary between HyperOS versions.
Google Play services is not installed on this device.
Unable to send the protection request. Please try again.
Find Autostart and allow GMS Protect.
Choose No restrictions / Unrestricted for GMS Protect.
GMS Protect needs Modify system settings access to keep Google Play services and Google Play Store in the HyperOS no-restriction list. Existing entries are preserved.
Allow Modify system settings to preserve and repair all three MILLET package entries.
Repair GMS + Play Store + GMS Protect MILLET
GMS, Play Store, and GMS Protect were verified in MILLET.
Modify system settings is not enabled yet.
Could not verify all three packages in the HyperOS MILLET list.
Enable Modify system settings for GMS Protect.

Optional protection for China HyperOS builds. When enabled, GMS Protect keeps a lightweight background monitor that restores Google Play services to the Aurogon allowlist after screen-off policy changes.
Background timing: 40 seconds after screen off -> at 2 minutes -> every 10 minutes while the screen stays off. One final refresh runs when the screen turns on, then the schedule stops.
Unable to change Aurogon Allowlist mode.
Monitors screen state to maintain the GMS Aurogon allowlist.
Protecting the GMS allowlist while the screen is off.
Enable Autostart for GMS Protect so protection can be restored after reboot. When you return, the app checks the setting and automatically continues to the next required permission.
Autostart is off. Enable it so GMS Protect can restore protection after reboot.

Allow Modify system settings so GMS Protect can automatically include Google Play services, Play Store, and GMS Protect itself in MILLET. All other entries are preserved and read back for verification.
Verify which protection mechanisms actually work on this device
Check HyperOS / PowerKeeper support and whether event-driven self-repair has been verified on this ROM.
